description: probe set for the one-verb-per-claim rule: 25 labels with a sentence holding >=2 distinct purpose verbs, 25 with >=2 risk verbs (and none of the purpose kind). Drawn from 6000 dump ids shuffled with seed 20261006, excluding every id in an existing label set. Not annotated.
